the applicant who passed the Matriculation exam earlier is considered first. Final selection is subject to verification of original testimonials. Applicants should ensure their name, father's name and date of birth exactly match those recorded in their Matriculation or equivalent certificate. Any deviation found during Document Verification will lead to cancellation of candidature and also debarment. In case of selection, applicants are required to report for Document/Certificate Verification with their originals.
important_instructions: The decision of IRCTC in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection, etc., shall be final. No correspondence for engagement will be entertained. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature, and no correspondence will be entertained in the matter. Candidature of applicants shall be cancelled if they fail to produce the required original testimonials for verification, or if any other discrepancy is noticed. No daily allowance/conveyance allowance or travelling allowance will be paid to applicants called for document verification. After selection for engagement, requests to change the trade will not be entertained. Applicants will be trained only for the trade in which they have been selected. Applicants selected for training will not be allowed to withdraw from training, except for reasons beyond their control.

Applicants will be selected purely as per merit. IRCTC has not appointed any agents to act on its behalf. Applicants are warned not to fall for lures based on any such claims being made by persons or agencies.

Any applicant found using unfair means of any kind in the document verification, or sending someone else in their place to appear for document verification and attempting to impersonate, will be disqualified. Applicants found submitting forged/fake certificates or documents of any kind, for securing eligibility and/or obtaining privileges, will have their candidature rejected. Applicants shall not bring in, or attempt to bring in, any political or other influence to further their interest regarding the engagement. Candidature of such applicants is liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: IRCTC West Zone Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Quick Summary
content_sections.text: Who is recruiting? Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd. (IRCTC), West Zone, Mumbai. Which posts? Computer Operator and Programming Assistant (COPA), Executive – Procurement, HR Executive – Payroll and Employee Data Management, and Marketing Operations and Analytics. How many vacancies? 27 (COPA-12, Executive-Procurement-6, HR Executive-3, Marketing Operations and Analytics-6). Who can apply? Candidates meeting the trade-specific eligibility below (Matriculation + ITI for COPA; graduation/pursuing graduation for the other three trades), with Matriculation passed with minimum 50% aggregate marks from a recognized Board, and within the age limit as on 18/08/25. Application start date: 30.09.2026. Last date: 18.10.2026. Application mode: Online, with prior registration on the apprenticeshipindia.gov.in portal. Job location: Mumbai or its Regional Offices/Units under IRCTC/West Zone.

content_sections.text: Applicants should have already passed, or be pursuing, the prescribed qualification notified against each position, as on 30.09.2026. In addition, candidates should have passed the Matriculation Examination with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate from a recognized Board.

content_sections.heading: IRCTC West Zone Apprentice Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit for all posts, as on 18/08/25 , is 15 (completed) to 25 years , with the following relaxation: *Ex-servicemen's upper age limit is relaxed by an additional 10 years, to the extent of service rendered in the Defence Forces, plus 3 years, provided they have put in a minimum of 6 months' service at a stretch - except ex-servicemen who have already joined Government Services on the civil side after availing Ex-servicemen status for the purpose of their engagement. Ex-servicemen, their children, and children of Armed Forces personnel will be engaged for Apprenticeship as per the following: Children of deceased/disabled Ex-servicemen, including those killed/disabled during peace time. Children of Ex-servicemen. Children of Serving Jawans. Children of Serving Officers. Ex-Servicemen.

content_sections.heading: IRCTC West Zone Apprentice Stipend
content_sections.text: The training period is one year (as mentioned against each post). Selected candidates engaged as Apprentices will be paid a monthly stipend as per the prescribed rates under the Apprenticeship Act.

content_sections.heading: IRCTC West Zone Apprentice Reservation Policy
content_sections.text: Reservation of Vacancies: Government guidelines for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-Serviceman candidates will be followed, with applicable age relaxation. Reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS): Government guidelines for EWS candidates will be followed. Applicants are required to submit their EWS Certificate if claiming against the EWS quota.

content_sections.heading: IRCTC West Zone Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: There is no written test or viva . Selection follows this mode: Selection is based on a merit list prepared on the percentage of marks obtained in the Matriculation examination. In case of a grading system of marking, the average of the highest and lowest marks in the scale will be taken. If two applicants have the same marks, the applicant with the older age is preferred. If the dates of birth are also the same, the applicant who passed the Matriculation exam earlier is considered first. Final selection is subject to verification of original testimonials. Candidates on the Stand-by list will be offered to join only on receipt of details of absentees and rejected candidates from the Merit list. Offers are issued strictly in order of merit. Shortlisted candidates should be in readiness to report to the concerned office for Document/Certificate Verification at short notice.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for IRCTC West Zone Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must submit legible, self-attested scanned copies of the following documents at the time of application: 10th Standard Mark Sheet and ITI standard mark sheet. Graduation Degree and Marksheet, for trades where the eligibility criteria is based on Graduation. Certificate for proof of date of birth (Standard 10 or its equivalent certificate or mark sheet indicating date of birth, or School Leaving Certificate indicating date of birth). Consolidated ITI mark sheet of all semesters of the trade applied for, or Provisional National Trade Certificate indicating marks. National Trade Certificate issued by NCVT/SCVT, or Provisional National Trade Certificate issued by NCVT/SCVT. Caste certificate, for SC/ST/OBC applicants. Disability certificate, in case of PwBD applicants. Discharge Certificate/Serving Certificate, in case of applicants applying against the Ex-Servicemen quota. A hard copy of a colour photograph (size 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm), taken not later than three months before the date of application, with a clear front view and without cap or sunglasses. IRCTC may reject applications at any stage for an old/unclear photograph, or for significant variation between the submitted photograph and the applicant's actual appearance. Applicants are advised to keep two additional copies of the same photograph ready and carry them at the time of Document/Certificate Verification. Shortlisted candidates are required to submit original documents along with 2 self-attested photocopies on the day of Document Verification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IRCTC West Zone Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme portal, https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. Apply online for the IRCTC/West Zone Apprentice engagement between 30.09.2026 and 18.10.2026. Keep scanned, self-attested copies of all required documents (listed above) ready before applying. Applicants have to produce details of their registration made on the apprenticeshipindia.gov.in portal, as part of the application process. Applicants should ensure their name, father's name and date of birth exactly match those recorded in their Matriculation or equivalent certificate. Any deviation found during Document Verification will lead to cancellation of candidature and also debarment. In case of selection, applicants are required to report for Document/Certificate Verification with their originals.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The decision of IRCTC in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection, etc., shall be final. No correspondence for engagement will be entertained. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature, and no correspondence will be entertained in the matter. Candidature of applicants shall be cancelled if they fail to produce the required original testimonials for verification, or if any other discrepancy is noticed. No daily allowance/conveyance allowance or travelling allowance will be paid to applicants called for document verification. After selection for engagement, requests to change the trade will not be entertained. Applicants will be trained only for the trade in which they have been selected. Applicants selected for training will not be allowed to withdraw from training, except for reasons beyond their control. Applicants will be selected purely as per merit. IRCTC has not appointed any agents to act on its behalf. Applicants are warned not to fall for lures based on any such claims being made by persons or agencies. Any applicant found using unfair means of any kind in the document verification, or sending someone else in their place to appear for document verification and attempting to impersonate, will be disqualified. Applicants found submitting forged/fake certificates or documents of any kind, for securing eligibility and/or obtaining privileges, will have their candidature rejected. Applicants shall not bring in, or attempt to bring in, any political or other influence to further their interest regarding the engagement. Candidature of such applicants is liable to be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC) for engagement of apprentice trainees under the West Zone.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available in IRCTC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 27 vacancies available across various trades and executive roles in the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation West Zone.

faq.question: Q3. What are the key dates for submitting the online application?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 30 September 2026 and concludes on 18 October 2026. Interested candidates must submit their forms before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required for the COPA post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Computer Operator and Programming Assistant (COPA) post must have completed Matriculation along with an ITI Certificate affiliated to NCVT or SCVT.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to these apprentice posts?
faq.answer: The age of the candidates should generally be between 15 and 25 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any application fees required to apply for IRCTC Apprentice?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for submitting the online form for the IRCTC Apprentice Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for these apprenticeship positions?
faq.answer: Selection is completely merit-based, derived from the percentage of marks obtained in the matriculation examination, followed by the verification of original testimonials.

faq.question: Q8. Where should candidates register before applying online?
faq.answer: Applicants must first register themselves on the official government apprenticeship portal at www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in before applying for the advertised posts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary or stipend structure for selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected apprentices will receive a stipend determined in accordance with the rules defined under the Apprenticeship Act during their contract period.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates can access the official notification PDF, complete application links, and find further updates directly on the official IRCTC website or through the provided important links table.
